question: Is direction D002 already explored or contradicted: Keep the refined scope of D001 and make the recency-decoupling explicit in the evaluation: the temporal layer is valid-time (as-of) gating applied post hoc across BM25, dense and hybrid retrievers; the benchmark is built by walking amendment chains so that a deliberately oversampled stratum of queries has a gold in-force version that is not the latest, with gold assigned by version identity and contamination measured per stratum. Report effects separately for the latest-gold and non-latest-gold strata, always including a recency-only baseline, and treat a null or small effect on the non-latest stratum as an informative negative result about when temporal re-ranking is unnecessary.?
rationale: A refined direction must be checked against existing work before it is recommended.
